# DevMesh v1.0.3

Release focused on self-contained Java 21 runtime bundles.

## Changes

- Added configuration-free `--version` / `-V` CLI output.
- Synchronized the CLI, TUI, JAR manifest, and release version at `1.0.3`.
- Added `bin/devmesh`, `bin/devmesh.bat`, and `bin/devmesh.ps1` launch scripts.
- Packaged `devmesh.jar`, a Java 21 runtime image, and launcher scripts together for Linux, Windows, and macOS.

## Runtime bundle layout

```text
devmesh.jar
runtime/
bin/devmesh
bin/devmesh.bat
bin/devmesh.ps1
```

## Downloads

- `devmesh-jdk21-linux-x64.tar.gz`
- `devmesh-jdk21-windows-x64.zip`
- `devmesh-jdk21-macos-x64.tar.gz`

The bundles are generated with `jlink` and do not require a separate Java 21 installation.

## Validation

- `./gradlew clean test engineeringValidation shadowJar`
- `java -jar devmesh.jar --version`
- Bundled Java 21 runtime launches DevMesh successfully.
